items.stem: A single parent provides more than half the cost of keeping up a home for a qualifying child. Which filing status is generally most advantageous?

options.rationale: Correct: a single taxpayer maintaining a home for a qualifying person generally qualifies for head of household, which gives a larger standard deduction than single.
The taxpayer is single, so MFJ is unavailable.
That status requires a deceased spouse within the prior two years.

options.rationale: Reinvested dividends that were already taxed add to basis.
